qwen3_asr.finding: Current official Qwen3-ASR documentation/source exposes German-capable offline and streaming recognition and returns recognized language/text. In the inspected official streaming surface, no Whisper-style no-speech probability/threshold contract was identified. Absence from the inspected surface is not proof that no internal silence behavior exists.

faster_whisper.finding: Current faster-whisper source exposes an explicit VAD filter path plus no_speech_threshold and hallucination_silence_threshold controls, providing an admitted comparison architecture for non-speech suppression.

hypothesis: Qwen3-ASR may remain a viable German ASR candidate if non-speech admission is owned by Frankenstein's deterministic acoustic/turn controller rather than delegated implicitly to ASR decoding.
counterhypothesis: The observed 'Ich.' on digital silence may indicate model/runtime false-positive behavior severe enough that an external VAD gate either cannot suppress real room-noise hallucinations reliably or adds unacceptable missed-speech/latency cost, making the Whisper/faster-whisper baseline superior for the actual voice loop.

next_discriminator.promotion_rule: Do not grant German-quality or streaming credit until the same-target fixture comparison is observed. After non-speech and German quality are characterized, exercise the official Qwen3-ASR streaming path for partial stability, endpoint latency and cancellation.

coordination.reason: The canonical Qwen3-ASR target-runtime semantic claim remains open and already owns this experiment family. This checkpoint narrows its next discriminator without creating parallel execution.
